master_protocol_full_compliance: NOT EXECUTED: standalone B-v1 uses theoretical baseline only; no matched simulated random tickets are generated/evaluated by this source.
structure_bank_is_not_baseline: The random bank is scored and maximized by structure_profile. It is a model candidate search bank, not an unselected random comparator.

proposed_separate_random_validation.suggestion: Separate new artifact: generate 10000 independent random 3-line portfolios for each historical target, each line uniformly sampled without replacement from 1..45; compare with predeclared three-line portfolio only if its B selection rule is specified. B-v1 itself emits one ticket per model, so do not claim this three-line baseline already matches a B-v1 portfolio. For strict B-v1 comparison use a one-ticket random baseline for the identical targets/anchors/horizons. Never include target 1245.
